raw_segments.text: I beg your pardon, Dr. Lanyon," he replied civilly enough.
"'What you say is very well founded, and my impatience has shown its heels to my politeness.
I come here at the instance of your colleague, Dr. Henry Jekyll, on a piece of business of
He paused and put his hand to his throat, and I could see, in spite of his collected
manner, that he was wrestling against the approaches of the hysteria.
